title: What We Still Have to Solve

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The constructive direction is a civilization able to detect mistakes and change course.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That means preserving evidence, protecting challenge, and testing assumptions before scaling commitments.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: AI could widen that feedback, rather than decide society's values.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with Why Solving One Bottleneck Reveals Another, then follow The Corrigible Civilization.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it to judge a solution by the complete service people actually receive.
